decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core cutting and creasing line, it remains relatively cheap to carry and another year without an adverse signal supports keeping this option open.
The sheet preparation module fits directly into the existing postpress workflow offer, so its low incremental carrying cost and continued strategic fit favor retention.
The B2 multifinisher is both near the firm's established capabilities and a stated focus product, making early withdrawal unlikely while automated B2 finishing demand continues to develop.

The hybrid saddle stitcher stays within the firm's familiar booklet-making domain, and with no clear negative market evidence it is still worth preserving despite somewhat higher niche risk than the other close-in products.
